svg.title: Geohash grid over a label-free city map
svg.desc: The original four-by-four boundary grid and San Francisco street geometry are retained. Street names, geohash names, and green cell highlights are omitted; the black map-attribution box remains.
svg.metadata: Street and building geometry from OpenStreetMap contributors; layout follows boundary-issue.png.

g.text: Map tiles by Stamen Design, under CC BY 3.0. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
